The '''Baradium Mine''' was a [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Denova]].<ref name="Tor" />

After the [[Eternal Empire]] was defeated, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] loyalists under the command of General [[Amos Rike]] [[Assault on Denova|displaced]] [[Eternal Alliance]] forces and seized control of the baradium mines. As Rike was planning to use the baradium against the the Eternal Alliance, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Bey'wan Aygo]] sent a small strike team to recapture them. After a confrontation between Rike and the strike team, Rike was eliminated and the Alliance retook control of the mines.<ref name="Uprising" /> After the assault, [[Alliance Intelligence (Eternal Alliance)|Alliance Intelligence]] sent a report to the [[Alliance Commander]] mentioning that while the Eternal Alliance would benefit of using the explosive material, at the end holding and defending the mines would drain their resources.<ref name="Codex" />
